81.9-Acre Trophy Whitetail Hunting & Recreational Property
Rare opportunity to own an 81.9-acre property that has been enrolled in a professional trophy whitetail management program designed to produce and maintain mature deer. The property has been strategically managed to include food, security cover, bedding areas, fawning habitat, and carefully planned select-cut areas with a robust ATV trail for accessing all points of the property.
Large established food plots provide excellent forage, while approximately 34 acres of native grasses and goldenrod offer tremendous additional potential. These areas could be further hunting opportunities throughout the property.
The timber has been selectively managed to create a diverse habitat, with bedding and security cover established throughout the acreage. The result is a property designed not simply for hunting deer, but for managing and producing mature whitetails.
Adding versatility, approximately 14 acres along Bush Road present an excellent opportunity for additional building lots creating potential for future development while maintaining the core recreational and hunting value of the property.
The property also includes an existing 1,490-square-foot, four-bedroom home that offers a great opportunity for renovation and improvement. The home currently benefits from FREE natural gas, helping reduce future ownership costs. An open shed and existing silo are additional improvements that contribute to the property's utility.
The property offers wonderful hilltop eastern and northern views, creating spectacular sunrise vistas and expansive views across the surrounding countryside.

Whether your goal is to own a premier whitetail hunting property, experience country living, or explore the additional building-lot potential, this property offers an exceptional combination of investment, recreation, and natural beauty.
ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:  FREE GAS, GMO’s and Timber Convey. 2.5 miles to French Creek, 4.16 miles to Clymer, 4.6 miles to PA Line.
